steps: An existing stationary declaration opens with independent platform movement controls. An unchanged Check produces no Apply ticket or author writes.
Explicit vertical motion rejects zero endpoint and zero speed without clamping, reviews schema6 while preserving unrelated source spellings and geometry, and Cancel discards the review.
Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain the same focused mode and reviewed source. Endpoint, speed and Check/Apply/Cancel remain reachable without horizontal overflow.

Apply changes only the ordinary source draft. Save changes only the physics document; reopening restores endpoint and speed. Disabling movement retains schema6, and cancelling that review preserves the saved route.

Space-map offset and size controls each review exactly one geometry leaf while retaining platformMotion, character motion and any one-way declarations. Both reviews are cancelled; this browser test does not execute the native runtime.
